reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but not the occurrence-to-day weekend pipeline of getUpcomingDates, which it copies instead of extracting.

duplication.why: The isDailyWithSkippedWeekends computation, the daily-weekend filter and the skip-or-adjust map are copied verbatim from getUpcomingDates (and the same rule also exists in shared/schedules getNextDate).

placement.why: A schedule handler in server/schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates, registered the same way.

scope.why: Focused on the new handler and tests, plus an unrelated reformatting of a filter call in getUpcomingDates.

maintainability.why: A change to how weekend occurrences are treated now has to be made in two handlers in the same file; the three-day lookback is commented but the shared rule is not factored.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no abstraction is routed around, the shared step simply does not exist yet.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied filter/map chain in getDatesInRange is visibly the same as getUpcomingDates, not disguised.
